results.title: Bail Denied To Nayan Raheja Because Of Non-Appearance Before ED.
results.description: In late September 2026, Special Judge (PMLA) Sachin Jain of the Saket District Court dismissed the anticipatory bail application filed by Nayan N. Raheja, former director of Raheja Developers Ltd. The court recorded that of 7 summonses served on him, Raheja had appeared only in 2 before the Gurugram Zonal Office of the Enforcement Directorate ...
